RoomsCreateFirst: Pick a type, invite the people you work with, and drop in your files. It takes a minute — and everything you have just seen starts working on your own documents.
RoomsGroups: Organize rooms by specific features to quickly find what you need. Create groups and switch between them right above the list.
RoomsMembers: Every room has its member list in the Info panel. Add portal contacts and set a role for each member — from viewing files to managing the entire room.
RoomsPlaces: {{recent}}, {{favorites}} and {{trash}} gather files from your rooms: recently opened, starred and deleted — the latter can still be restored. {{templates}} — your room templates. {{archive}} — rooms you no longer work in, restorable anytime.
RoomsTemplates: Turn any room into a template — its settings, structure and files are saved. Create a new room from it in a click, all that's left is to add members.
RoomsTypes: {{collaboration}} for teamwork, {{vdr}} for secure file sharing, {{publicRoom}} for external access, {{custom}} for your own scenarios.
